---
title: "After the course"
aliases:
  - ../eu-frames-three-days/after.html
---

The course leaves you with a report of your own under version control, and the companion curriculum holds the material that three days can only touch. Each module stands on its own, so take the one that your own work needs.

- [Meta-analysis](../../companion/meta-analysis.qmd) puts the five Multi100 analyses on one scale, and asks what a pooled estimate can say about five analyses of one dataset.
- [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd) builds the country-year panel from the sixteen Eurobarometer waves, step by step, and checks it against the files that the course committed.
- [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd), [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd) and [Missing answers](../../companion/missingness.qmd) take apart the decisions about measurement that the menu opened.
- [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) goes one step below the scales and fits a single item of the instrument as a yes-or-no outcome on the respondents.
- [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd) works through the graph of the claim at a slower pace, and ends on a graph for a question of your own.
- [Simulation as a method](../../companion/simulation.qmd) generates data from known values, to test what a method recovers.
- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) sets out the debate in full, with its critics read against the curve of the claim.
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) shows how to deposit the report that you wrote.
